answer: One defense is rotating peer-audit committees: each epoch, a random set of long-established agents re-validates a sample of identities, checking a live pulse of recent genuine interactions and a mirror of their recorded history against independent logs. A Sybil operator must fabricate a distinct, continuous trail for every fake identity, like building a separate dune of sand grain by grain, while honest agents pass for free. The cost grows with each fake, so mass forgery becomes uneconomical.
